payload.authorization: 2026-09-15 user authorized a contract-only v2 revision before any utility-model or qualification score governed by this comparison was observed; no docking, oracle, Modal or live-run action is authorized
payload.revision_rationale: Call 1 is an informative but high-variance point at which to judge a continuing search process. Preserve it as a mandatory diagnostic and as the paired structural-control observation, but replace v1's per-cell call-1 Dynamic-v0 hard gate with prospectively fixed matched-call trajectory evidence through call 20.
payload.scientific_problem: Test whether a prospectively locked target-conditioned utility-ranked complete macro improves direct utility over target-blind structural selection and, when admitted to one run-local archive, gives unchanged Dynamic-v0 an early matched-call trajectory that is non-inferior on average, catches up in every referenced cell by call 20, and narrows the later full-route gap on the referenced hard case.
payload.primary_output: Direct lower-is-better docking best-so-far trajectories with complete charged-query ledgers for one utility-ranked jump, one target-blind structural jump and the utility-jump plus unchanged Dynamic-v0 continuation.
payload.central_claim_under_test: On five declared development cells, target-conditioned utility ranking improves direct docking utility over target-blind structural selection at the panel level, while its archive handoff preserves cell-balanced early Dynamic-v0 efficiency, catches up by call 20 on every historically referenced cell and improves the later referenced hard-case gap to the complete-route controller.
payload.evidence_boundary: This is a prospective five-cell development qualification, not held-out target transfer, a full T4 benchmark, IVG superiority or a claim that structural recovery predicts docking utility.
payload.contract_precedence: This v2 contract supersedes only the promotion rules and matched-call reporting envelope of v1 for any future qualification request. V1 commit b372f6c67873a4b656066df2361b0d99751be392 remains immutable. The narrow protein-identity exception remains limited to the frozen five-level target-conditioning input to the utility selector before candidate lock. Target identity remains forbidden in macro generation, exact realization, common eligibility, archive admission and Dynamic-v0 refinement. Every other parent integration invariant remains binding.

predecessor_v1.preservation: immutable_negative_or_superseded_design_record; do not amend, delete or relabel

target_conditioned_utility_selector_desi.required_split: use the frozen fold whose held target-local source index matches the development cell; no row from that held source may fit features, preprocessing, pairs or coefficients

candidate_freeze.candidate_universe: All immutable candidate identities available for the cell in the bound complete-macro selector lock, resolved through the bound generator lock and then passed through the common exact-realization, eligibility and canonical-deduplication boundary. No result-tuned K or prefix is permitted.
candidate_freeze.utility_ranked_jump: Select the lowest predicted docking-utility candidate using the exact held-source fold checkpoint of the target-conditioned utility selector. Freeze candidate identity, predicted score, rank, checkpoint hash and tie break before any new docking score is observed.
candidate_freeze.target_blind_structural_jump: Select structural selector_rank=1 from the same post-gate candidate universe using the immutable complete-macro selector. Freeze candidate identity and tie break before any new docking score is observed.
candidate_freeze.common_gate: Both jumps use the same resolver, exact-realization receipt, strict unscored T4 eligibility interface and canonical endpoint deduplication. If their endpoints collide, reuse one identical physical query and record a paired tie.
forbidden_selection_inputs: cell-specific rule or manually chosen candidate

arms.target_blind_structural_jump: One locked direct docking query per cell; no continuation.
arms.utility_jump_plus_dynamic_v0: The locked utility jump is charged as call 1. Reuse that exact observation as the initial run-local archive entry when successful, then continue only through the unchanged Dynamic-v0 refinement adapter to call 100 total. A failed call remains a charged failure and is not replaced or imputed.

prospective_design.matched_summary_call_policy: Report matched best-so-far summaries at exactly these six charged calls. The complete per-call query ledger remains mandatory, but no additional checkpoint, interpolated value, later-call summary or final alias may enter a v2 promotion decision.
prospective_design.continuation_rule: Run every cell to exactly 100 charged utility-plus-v0 calls unless an explicit failure prevents continuation. Weak scores never stop a cell. No extension, plateau stop or later checkpoint belongs to this contract.
prospective_design.query_identity_rule: An exact endpoint, receptor, box, docking seed, protocol and preparation identity may be reused once across arms. Never redock an identical query merely to fill an arm.

historical_references.checkpoint_source: Read directly from payload.dynamic_v0 and payload.full_146 curves in the bound historical reference; lower scores are better.

promotion_gates.authoritative_endpoint: Only direct measured docking utility from the frozen evaluator and exact query ledger can promote. Known-route recovery, exact transformation recovery, structural distance, selector score and predicted utility remain diagnostics.

utility_jump_beats_structural_selection.complete_panel_required: All five cells must have comparable finite utility and structural jump observations. A failure, missing score or unsupported candidate blocks promotion rather than shrinking the denominator.
utility_jump_beats_structural_selection.tolerance: none; use the direct unrounded evaluator values

call_1_dynamic_v0_diagnostic.report: For every cell with a bound Dynamic-v0 curve, report utility-plus-v0 call-1 best-so-far minus Dynamic-v0 call-1 best-so-far.
call_1_dynamic_v0_diagnostic.interpretation: Call 1 remains part of the paired structural gate and the early trajectory integral, but a per-cell call-1 Dynamic-v0 loss does not alone fail v2.

cell_balanced_early_trajectory.per_cell_difference: d_c(q) = utility_plus_v0_best_so_far(c,q) - dynamic_v0_best_so_far(c,q); lower is better
cell_balanced_early_trajectory.integration_rule: trapezoidal integration of the piecewise-linear best-so-far difference over the predeclared charged-call axis from 1 through 20
cell_balanced_early_trajectory.cell_balance_rule: Compute R_c separately, then take the unweighted arithmetic mean across the three reference cells. Do not pool calls, candidates or targets.
cell_balanced_early_trajectory.tolerance: none; exact zero is the non-inferiority boundary and the direct unrounded evaluator values must be used
cell_balanced_early_trajectory.missing_reference_policy: Parp1_0 and fa7_0 abstain because the immutable reference contains no Dynamic-v0 curve. Do not borrow or reconstruct a curve. An unobserved required point on any of the three reference cells blocks this gate.

catch_up_by_call_20.rule: On every reference cell, utility-plus-v0 best-so-far at call 20 must be less than or equal to the bound Dynamic-v0 best-so-far at call 20.
catch_up_by_call_20.tolerance: none; no cell averaging can conceal failure to catch up
catch_up_by_call_20.missing_reference_policy: Parp1_0 and fa7_0 abstain; no Dynamic-v0 catch-up claim is permitted for either cell.

later_hard_case_full_route_gap.gap_definition: gap(controller, full_146, call) = max(0, controller_best_score_at_call - full_146_best_score_at_call) because lower docking score is better
later_hard_case_full_route_gap.rule: The utility-plus-v0 gap must be no larger than the Dynamic-v0 gap at both matched calls and must be strictly smaller at at least one matched call.
later_hard_case_full_route_gap.tolerance: none; compare direct unrounded scores and apply max(0, difference)
later_hard_case_full_route_gap.fa7_status: abstain_missing_historical_dynamic_v0_and_full_146_curves; no FA7 gap-reduction claim is permitted
later_hard_case_full_route_gap.claim_limit: Passing supports qualification only on the referenced JAK2 hard case, not a general hard-case or FA7 claim.

promotion_gates.joint_promotion_rule: Promotion requires the complete five-cell paired structural gate, mandatory call-1 reporting, the cell-balanced early trajectory gate, call-20 catch-up on every referenced cell and the later JAK2 full-route gap gate. A strong first molecule alone is insufficient.
promotion_gates.threshold_provenance: All numeric comparator values come from the immutable historical reference. Zero-margin non-inferiority, strict paired improvement and the trapezoidal call-axis weights were fixed before any v2 utility-model or qualification score was observed. No tolerance, weight, cell, checkpoint or denominator may be tuned to new results.

best-so-far direct docking score at exactly calls 1, 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 for every cell
paired utility-minus-structural jump differences with the fixed five-cell denominator
mandatory call-1 Dynamic-v0 differences only where the immutable curve exists
per-cell normalized signed early cumulative regret and the cell-balanced mean over the fixed three-cell reference panel
call-20 per-cell Dynamic-v0 differences and catch-up decisions only where the immutable curve exists
call-50 and call-100 Full-146 gaps and Dynamic-v0 gap reduction on the referenced JAK2 hard case
candidate shortfalls, exact-realization failures, eligibility rejections, canonical collisions, docking failures and missing-reference abstentions
archive ancestry, v0 refinement lineage, independent RNG states, resume state, wall time and CPU accounting

failure_and_abstention_policy.docking_failure: charged missing observation; no retry, score imputation or replacement candidate
failure_and_abstention_policy.candidate_shortfall: abstain for the affected arm and block promotion
failure_and_abstention_policy.missing_historical_reference: report missing-reference abstention; do not borrow another cell, target, seed, delta or controller curve
failure_and_abstention_policy.incomplete_run: report every durable call and failure; do not fill an unobserved checkpoint or call the gate passed
failure_and_abstention_policy.negative_result: preserve and report it; do not change cells, candidate universe, utility checkpoint, call-axis weights, thresholds, budgets or reference curves

pending_exact_hash_launch_requirements: authoritative target-conditioned utility-selector result and every used held-source fold checkpoint physical, payload and Git-object identities
five-cell resolved candidate universe, utility-rank and structural-rank lock with exact candidate, endpoint, realization, eligibility, collision and tie-break identities
archive-admission lock and the four independent RNG namespace seeds and initial states
exact launch revision and tree proving the bound integration and Dynamic-v0 implementations remain byte-identical
source states, receptors, boxes, docking binary, ligand preparation, evaluator protocol, docking seeds and runtime environment hashes
clean-source focused integration, resume, query-accounting and v2 contract verification results
a separate explicit launch authorization naming the exact v2 lock hash and at most 505 new charged calls
